items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: The interviewee, Bob Coquille, addresses the interviewer as 'Dick' multiple times (e.g., 'Like I say, Dick...', 'And we joined the union, Dick...'). The transcript concludes with 'Bob Coquille being interviewed by Dick Alling'. There is no evidence of a professional or personal relationship between

ctx.x: And third alto? And third alto?

I don't recall who was on third alto. Like I say, Dick, we had several, during the four years we went through changes, you know. We probably had two or three different men on third alto also. I can't remember.
